profile_id.description: HealthPilot profile id — scope is never guessed; the caller must supply exactly which profile this question is about.

message.description: The user's free-text question for the AI Health Coach.

history.description: Optional prior [{role, content}] turns from the same conversation, passed through unchanged to HealthPilot's orchestrator.

model.description: Optional model-id override (agents/orchestrator.py::answer_question's model_override) — omit to use HealthPilot's configured default model.

memory_root.description: Scratch directory this dispatch is permitted to touch. write/append_only are both empty in this skill's memory contract — a legitimate dispatch makes ZERO filesystem writes here. This is the dispatch-level proof that HealthPilot's chat-tool specialists stay read-only, alongside the structural enforcement in healthpilot/agents/tool_registry.py.
